text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Interim, four folds. A step of 5% of effective capacity is added to k of the power lags (k=1 origin, k=2 also yesterday's, k=3 also last week's) of clean forecast rows, pooled over all Primaries (sums over Primaries and refits). The event-level reading is the actual value plus the step. Solid: lagged form; dashed: lagless form, which has no lags and so stays flat.'
text.tspan: Interim, four folds. A step of 5% of effective capacity is added to k of the power lags (k=1 origin, k=2
also yesterday's, k=3 also last week's) of clean forecast rows, pooled over all Primaries (sums over
Primaries and refits). The event-level reading is the actual value plus the step. Solid: lagged form;
dashed: lagless form, which has no lags and so stays flat.
